map.示例：太阳光到地球的时间: Example: the time for sunlight to reach the Earth
map.日地平均距离约 1.496×10¹¹ m，c=2.998×10⁸ m/s，t=d: The mean Sun-Earth distance is about 1.496 x 10^11 m and c = 2.998 x 10^8 m/s, so t = d/c is about 499 s, about 8.3 minutes. The Sun we see is therefore the Sun of about 8 minutes ago.
map.为什么叫「光行时」？: Why is it called light travel time?
map.信息以有限光速传播，观测到的远方天体其实是它过去的样子，距离越远看到的越早。: Information travels at a finite speed of light, so a distant object observed is actually as it was in the past; the farther away it is, the earlier the epoch we see.
map.1 光年≈9.46×10¹² km，约为日地距离的 63241 倍；最近的恒星比: One light-year is about 9.46 x 10^12 km, about 63241 times the Sun-Earth distance; the nearest star, Proxima Centauri, is about 4.24 light-years away.
